name: Purukuparli (Tiwi)

domain_history.domain: first ancestral man, son of Mudungkala, husband of Bima — institutes death and the Pukumani mortuary ceremony after the death of their son Jinani

notes: Central to the origin account of the Pukumani ceremony, the still-practiced Tiwi mortuary ritual. See trad_tiwi_pukumani.
